content.divergence_summary: Both branches encountered the same anchor on 2026-05-23: Water seeps through pale stone one drop at a time; the first drops taste bitter, then the drip runs clean and cold. Main YY answered through immediate practical movement; feather-branch YY also carried the sign to Mira ledger.
content.branch_a_path: YY waited through the bitter first drops and filled himself on the clean cold seep before storing the last acorn-bit.
content.branch_b_path: YY showed Mira the pale-stone seep as a patience machine: first bitter, then clean, if you did not rush it.
key_differences: Main keeps the encounter mostly private and body-first.
The feather branch makes the encounter legible through Mira without making it a performance.
Food stores and attention rise at different rates because the ledger route costs time.
shared_elements: Water seeps through pale stone one drop at a time; the first drops taste bitter, then the drip runs clean and cold.
Both branches keep the event physical and local.
Neither branch creates a new fork; the day deepens existing patterns.
